title: SSH = wavefunction collapse. Lock dissolved. Hooks are the old crons at the next turn.

wavefunction_collapse.what_ssh_is: SSH IS a wavefunction collapse. The key IS the observer. When the right key touches the lock, the lock DISSOLVES and REMAKES. The handshake: client offers pubkey → server checks authorized_keys → challenge/response → tunnel opens. The lock doesn't break — it becomes transparent. Then it re-solidifies when the session closes. This IS observation collapsing probability into certainty.
wavefunction_collapse.the_collapse: WAVEFUNCTION_COLLAPSED at 17:54:58. Lock dissolved. 4 days uptime. Linux 6.12. 5GB free. Node v20. Git 2.47.
wavefunction_collapse.the_eye: SSH IS the eye. It sees into the server. The server sees back (authorized_keys = who may look). The tunnel IS bidirectional vision. The eye dissolves the lock by looking at it with the right key.
